pool.text: The area was devastated by Elizabeth's flood.
Decision made to construct the New Waterway canal.
Railway line to Hook of Holland opened for service.
International ferry terminal began service to eastern England.
Hook of Holland was incorporated into the municipality of Rotterdam.
Hook of Holland became northern terminus of the Rheingold Express.
The railway line to Hook of Holland was electrified.
Around ten thousand Jewish children had reached Britain by war outbreak.
The settlement obtained its own ward council.
Rheingold Express service resumed with Hook of Holland as terminus.
Hook of Holland attained borough status within Rotterdam.
The borough council was replaced by an area committee.
Rail service to Rotterdam Centraal was closed in April.
Line reopened as extension of Rotterdam Metro light rail.
Hook of Holland's estimated population reached ten thousand five hundred sixty residents.
